'''Carta Railey''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Railey was a leader of the [[Velocity Mercenaries]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Carta Railey frequently piloted a [[Rihkxyrk assault fighter]] in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]].<ref name="SWG:DS" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateVelocityPilots.png|thumb|right|250px|All possible depictions of Carta Railey]]
Carta Railey appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Carta Railey was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. Carta Railey was a starfighter boss that had a low probability to spawn among a group of Velocity Mercenary starfighters in the Dantooine system.<ref name="SWG:DS" />
